name: Firewatch Fold

sources.note: The supplied survey records the two-face tower, alternate-face inspection, edge crossings, ladder route, direction-dependent extinguishing, and one-use extinguisher planning.

transformation: An original procedural two-face cutaway tower with explicit cell geometry, face inspection, edge seams, ladder traversal, one-use fire gates, alternate controls, and independent action-ledger replay.
assets: Original HTML, CSS, generated symbols, and JavaScript/Python implementation. No third-party artwork, fonts, source code, or runtime media are redistributed.
